title: Key Management & Trust Store
description: Implement the `wdd keygen` command in `lib/wdd/crypto.py`. This generates Ed25519 keypairs and creates the `keys/trusted.json` trust store.

requirements.crypto_lib: Use the standard `hashlib` or `cryptography` Python package to generate Ed25519 keys.

acceptance_criteria: Running `python -m wdd keygen` produces a valid public/private keypair and populates the trust store.
failure_modes: FAIL: Storing private keys in the repo without gitignoring them.
